notes: ACCESS: tier (a) direct HTTP fetch (curl with a real-browser UA) worked for every page requested - homepage, mega-menu category pages, and ~45 category/subcategory pages under Home & Living, Household, Kitchen, Office Supplies, Garden, Bath, Furniture, Men, Children, Luggage, Body Care. No block encountered; robots.txt has no blanket disallow and does not name Claude/anthropic bots. TREE: built by walking the site's own category nav server-rendered in each page's HTML (no client hydration needed - full nav + breadcrumb + productCount are present in the initial HTML), cross-checked against sitemap_pages.xml and the site's own /sitemap-c199459/ directory page for anything missed. Followed Home & Living > Home Textiles (9 top branches) fully; also checked Bath, Household (Laundry, Household Essentials, Haberdashery), Kitchen, Office Supplies (Archiving & Organizing), Furniture, Garden, Children, Men/Women clothing, Luggage & Leather Goods, Body Care for stray textile/storage nodes outside Home Textiles. QTY: taken from the embedded breadcrumb JSON field productCount (e.g. "productCount":"(45)") rendered next to each category's own h1/canonical, confirmed the endpoint name matches the requested slug on every leaf recorded. EXCLUDED: 7 Home Textiles sub-pages with no productCount of their own (Bedding for the winter c199553, Comfortable in summer/Linen bedding c199861, Sleep well course c200734, Summer comforters c199928, Summery blankets c202429, Wool blankets c199554, Woven carpets virgin wool c199557) - these are seasonal/editorial landing pages, not real listing pages, per rule 15/27. storage-c189845 (breadcrumb Garden>Garden Furniture>Storage, 3 products) excluded - inspected the 3 linked products and they are garden work/BBQ tables, not storage items; category label is misleading, actual products are Furniture. storage-furniture-c172278 (cabinets/chests-of-drawers/shelves) and office-cabinets-c200728 excluded as Furniture per storage.md SS21/SS15 (explicit Furniture-category placement). hangers-hooks-c172277 (coat racks, wall hooks under Furniture>Wardrobe Accessories) excluded - decorative/functional fixtures, not storage containers/organizers per storage.md's own lists. drinking-bottles-c200722, boards-c201066, folders-binders-c172244, kitchen-drawer-c199578 (editorial page) excluded as non-storage or non-listing pages. luggage-leather-goods-c175685 branch (suitcases/bags/wallets) excluded per storage.md SS6 (personal-carrying bags, not home storage). Parent-URL rule applied: Home Textiles, Bedding, Curtains and Table Linen parents have valid child subcategories so only the children are recorded, not the parent URL; Blankets and Carpets have no valid subcategories (their only 'children' were the excluded editorial pages) so they are recorded as leaves at their own URL. Kitchen Storage and Archiving & Organizing kept as grouping rows since they are dedicated storage-named nodes with multiple qualifying children; Laundry Baskets, Towel Racks, Clothes Storage, Food Storage and the two Tool Storage leaves are recorded standalone (not nested under Laundry / Bathroom Accessories / Men's Clothing / Garden Utensils / Hand Tools) because those parent sections are generic mixed-purpose nav nodes, not dedicated textile/storage hierarchies - forcing them in as group parents would misrepresent the site structure. Mosquito Nets, Pillows, Bread Boxes & Bags, Hanging File Folders, Clothes Storage and both Tool Storage rows flagged MEDIUM confidence per the respective rule files' ambiguity guidance.
